//! The shape of the data this adapter does not control: each wire shape is a `<Name>Schema`, its conversion into the core's type is an `impl TryFrom<<Name>Schema>` (or an `impl From<<Name>Schema>` where it cannot fail), and each refusal of a conversion is a `<Name>SchemaError`.
